info.brief: Extra native OS functions for games written using the Defold game engine.
info.description: Extra native OS functions for games written using the Defold game engine.

elements.name: defos.disable_maximize_button
elements.description: Disables the maximize button in the window title bar. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.disable_minimize_button
elements.description: Disables the minimize button in the window title bar. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.disable_window_resize
elements.description: Disables window resizing. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.set_window_title
elements.description: Sets the window title. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.set_maximized
elements.description: Sets the window maximized state. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.toggle_maximized
elements.description: Toggles the window maximized state. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.is_maximized
elements.description: Checks if the window is maximized. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.set_fullscreen
elements.description: Sets the window fullscreen state. On HTML5, this only works from defos.on_click() or defos.on_interaction(). Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.toggle_fullscreen
elements.description: Toggles the window fullscreen state. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.is_fullscreen
elements.description: Checks if the window is in fullscreen mode. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.set_borderless
elements.description: Sets the window borderless state. Platforms - Windows.

elements.name: defos.toggle_borderless
elements.description: Toggles the window borderless state. Platforms - Windows.

elements.name: defos.is_borderless
elements.description: Checks if the window is borderless. Platforms - Windows.

elements.name: defos.set_always_on_top
elements.description: Sets whether the window should always stay on top. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

parameters.name: always_on_top
parameters.doc: Whether to keep window on top

elements.name: defos.toggle_always_on_top
elements.description: Toggles whether the window should always stay on top. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.is_always_on_top
elements.description: Checks if the window is set to always stay on top. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.minimize
elements.description: Minimizes the window. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.activate
elements.description: Activates (focuses) the window. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.get_window_size
elements.description: Gets the window's size and position in screen coordinates. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.set_window_size
elements.description: Sets the window's size and position in screen coordinates. Passing nil for x and y will center the window. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.get_view_size
elements.description: Gets the game view size and position in screen coordinates. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.set_view_size
elements.description: Sets the game view size and position in screen coordinates. Passing nil for x and y will center the window. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.get_displays
elements.description: Returns information about all displays. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

returnvalues.name: displays
returnvalues.doc: Table of display information, indexed by number or display id

elements.name: defos.get_current_display_id
elements.description: Gets the ID of the game's current display. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.get_display_modes
elements.description: Gets all supported resolution modes for a display. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

parameters.name: display_id
parameters.doc: The display ID to get modes for

elements.name: defos.set_cursor_visible
elements.description: Sets the mouse cursor visibility. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.is_cursor_visible
elements.description: Checks if the mouse cursor is visible. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.is_mouse_in_view
elements.description: Checks if the mouse is within the game view area. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.on_mouse_enter
elements.description: Sets a callback for when the mouse enters the game view area. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Function to be called when mouse enters

elements.name: defos.on_mouse_leave
elements.description: Sets a callback for when the mouse leaves the game view area. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Function to be called when mouse leaves

elements.name: defos.get_cursor_pos
elements.description: Gets the cursor position in screen coordinates. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.get_cursor_pos_view
elements.description: Gets the cursor position in game view coordinates. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.set_cursor_pos
elements.description: Sets the cursor position in screen coordinates. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.set_cursor_pos_view
elements.description: Sets the cursor position in game view coordinates. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.set_cursor_clipped
elements.description: Clips cursor to current game view area. Platforms - Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.is_cursor_clipped
elements.description: Checks if the cursor is clipped to the game view area. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX.

elements.name: defos.set_cursor_locked
elements.description: Locks cursor movement. On HTML5 this only works from defos.on_click() or defos.on_interaction(). Platforms - Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.is_cursor_locked
elements.description: Checks if the cursor is locked. Platforms - Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.on_cursor_lock_disabled
elements.description: Sets a callback for when cursor lock is disabled (e.g. when user presses ESC on HTML5). Platforms - Windows, OSX, HTML5.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Function to be called when cursor lock is disabled

elements.name: defos.load_cursor
elements.description: Loads a custom hardware cursor. See README for supported formats per platform. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.set_cursor
elements.description: Sets the current cursor. See README for supported values. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.reset_cursor
elements.description: Resets the cursor to default. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.set_console_visible
elements.description: Shows/hides the console window. Platforms - Windows.

elements.name: defos.is_console_visible
elements.description: Checks if the console window is visible. Platforms - Windows.

elements.name: defos.on_interaction
elements.description: Sets a callback for user interaction with the canvas. Platforms - HTML5.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Function to be called on interaction

elements.name: defos.on_click
elements.description: Sets a callback for user click on the canvas. Platforms - HTML5.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Function to be called on click

elements.name: defos.get_bundle_root
elements.description: Gets the absolute path to the game's containing directory. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.set_window_icon
elements.description: Changes the game window's icon at runtime. Platforms - Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.get_arguments
elements.description: Returns command line arguments used to run the app. Platforms - Linux, Windows, OSX, HTML5.

elements.name: defos.CURSOR_ARROW
elements.description: Default arrow cursor

elements.name: defos.CURSOR_HAND
elements.description: Hand cursor

elements.name: defos.CURSOR_CROSSHAIR
elements.description: Crosshair cursor

elements.name: defos.CURSOR_IBEAM
elements.description: I-beam cursor

elements.name: defos.PATH_SEP
elements.brief: The system path separator ("\\" on Windows, "/" everywhere else)
elements.description: The system path separator ("\\" on Windows, "/" everywhere else)
